caseName: Birdette v. Wellstar Health Systems Cobb Hospital
caseNameFull: Birdette v. Wellstar Health Systems Cobb Hospital Harrington v. Harrington. In re Wright and Chong Hao Su v. City of Cincinnati, Ohio

opinions.text:
C. A. 11th Cir.;

App. Ct. Mass.;

Ct. App. Ohio, Hamilton County. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioners are allowed until June 4, 2012, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
